operational_simulation.organization_and_actor: Brazilian parcel or freight operator; control-tower supervisor and route operations analyst
processes: predict remaining delivery time and exception escalation
predict warehouse dwell and missed connection risk
detect sequence patterns preceding failed delivery or route recovery
operational_simulation.deterministic_baseline: event milestones, promised windows, route rules, cut-off tables, carrier SLAs, geofences, queue thresholds, and human escalation
operational_simulation.remaining_gap: Sequence-aware prediction is plausible, but the bounded outcomes overlap existing ETA, visibility, cold-chain, and exception-management products and repository cases.

training_data.observation_unit: shipment, route leg, warehouse dwell interval, or delivery attempt at a defined prediction timestamp
training_data.input_data: event history available before prediction, planned route and cut-offs, location, carrier, service level, capacity, weather and disruption context where lawfully available
training_data.target_or_reward: remaining time, missed connection, failed delivery, or recovery outcome
training_data.label_source: confirmed milestone timestamps, delivery result, exception closure and supervisor correction
training_data.prediction_time: before the next operational intervention or customer promise update
training_data.expected_volume: unknown; must be measured per operator, lane, service and event quality
training_data.class_balance: failed deliveries and severe exceptions are likely minority outcomes; exact balance unknown
training_data.historical_coverage: requires multiple seasonal periods and stable event definitions across carriers and facilities
training_data.train_validation_split: time-based split with holdout by later period and, where relevant, unseen lane, hub or carrier
training_data.leakage_risks: using final exception codes, later scans, customer-contact outcomes or revised ETA fields created after the prediction point
training_data.representativeness_risks: carrier, region, urban density, peak season, international clearance and service-level differences
training_data.feedback_loop: confirmed milestones, failed-delivery reasons, supervisor overrides and recovery outcomes
training_data.privacy_and_usage_constraints: minimize recipient and driver data, restrict location history, define retention and access controls
training_data.fallback_if_data_is_insufficient: retain deterministic milestone rules, SLA thresholds, statistical baselines and human control-tower review

portfolio_coherence.reason: The remaining sequence-model hypothesis does not establish a materially distinct actor, decision, integration boundary and outcome beyond current visibility/ETA products and existing repository forecasting or logistics cases.
